title: push
description: Saves the current drawing state (transformations, styles, etc.) to the stack. You can think about it as grouping element you want to affect. The transforms will affect all the elements in the groupd undistinctively. The push / pop gets computed alltogether and don't have awareness of what's both what's inside the stack and the transforms applied to it. You won't be able to ping a specific element, to isolate a single element, put it in an another push/pop.
